searchText: Anyone know if there was a tool for claiming ICO ETH using a private Bitcoin donation key? I lost the ETH claim receipt.. There must be some way of verifying those claim receipts so I imagine there may be something like this. Or if you know anyone that could help. I donated a bitcoin back in the day.. Thank you.. Or .. wrong channel? From looking at [0] and [1] , you really seem to need to have access to the seed to generate that receipt. Your private Bitcoin key doesn't come into play, as it was just a regular transaction (to an address associated with the random seed).
